I absolutely love this toner. It's very light and makes my skin feel so refreshed. I love the smell. I have SUPER sensitive skin and it feels so amazing. Highly recommend!!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again.

avis.titre: My favorite skin product--if you shave your face it's a MUST
avis.texte: This is the one skincare product I simply can't live without. I have been using it for years and it blows every other toner out of the water hands down–even the ones that cost as much as 3 times the price. I have combination-oily skin that is prone to breakouts as well as extremely sensitive. I also shave my face every single morning, which can do a lot of harm and create redness, welts, and abrasions. This product takes care of all of that. It soothes and relieves my skin and visibly decreases the redness. It clears up my pores and strips dirt from my skin. It leaves me feeling fresh every time. I never leave home without it. I use it in the AM after a morning cleanser–applying evenly to the face and wiping off with a cotton pad (wipe strategically and away from the face to prevent dirt buildups) and follow it with a mattifying SPF moisturizer. I LOVE this brand and I LOVE this product. If you are someone who shaves your face, or someone with sensitive and acne-prone skin, I can't recommend this product highly enough.
This stuff works great! The name is confusing but it's just a toner. Nice clean, fresh smell and I notice my skin is much brighter, tighter and better after using. Definitely recommend!
on my third bottle ... keep coming back to this one after trying another brands
I use this lotion / toner after the seaweed soap and have noticed a definite improvement in the clarity of my skin and it definitely feels less dry before I put moisturizer on than soap alone.
Mario Badescu got this product right. It helps balance oil while toning and does not feel harsh like other toners. I will buy this again and again.
My new go to! This toner is quite glorious. Huge change in my skin. Blemishes disappear so much faster with my daily use of this product after cleansing my face. Love this stuff!
My skin feels less dry. I use this after cleansing, before putting on serum and then moisturizer.

I knew I needed a toner in my daily skincare routine, so I set out to research the best toners for combo-type skin. Came across the Seaweed Cleansing Lotion and decided to give it a shot. Yes, this product is a toner! I know the name can be a bit deceiving. When trying out this product, I have to say I did break out a bit, especially on my forehead. My skin was not used to this product in the beginning and I should have tested it out in a small area before committing to use it all over my face. I waited a few weeks before trying it out again and it actually paired with my skin very well! A little goes a long way for me and I did notice the extra dirt and make-up residue my cotton ball grabs when sweeping off the toner across my face. My face feels refreshed after use! Overall, I would buy this product again.

avis.titre: Works so good on oily skin

This toner is universal for skin types and by far my favorite one I've tried. It's non irritating and has great ingredients- although called a lotion it's a regular liquid texture. I use this for my face, neck, and shoulders and then the glycolic acid toner from this line for my eye area.

this toner is a dream come true! my skin is flawless and beautiful and I cant get enough of this toner! highly recommend!

avis.titre: Weird product (I think I love it?)
avis.texte: I don't know how to review this magical product. So, I do love it because I have pretty severe perioral dermatitis (since going off birth control 2 years ago) that my dermatologist cannot figure out how to get rid of. I have spent hundreds on rx creams, supplements, antibiotics, beauty products, lotions etc. I tried this on a whim and I kid you not my dermatitis (which was super severe at the time- peeling skin, lots of bumps, really irritated) was dried up and healing in 24 hours after ONE use. So in that sense, its a miracle product. However, I can only use it on my chin because the rest of my face hates this lotion- I get clogged pores and little whiteheads from it everywhere else on my face. I have problem skin anyway so that doesn't really bother me; the rest of my face gets glycolic and my chin gets this. Happy :)

avis.titre: There's a reason something's the most universal!
avis.texte: While trying to find a nice, gentle, basic toner for the mornings I happened upon this 'seaweed cleansing lotion' about a year ago during the '21 Days of Beauty' and seeing it was alcohol free.. had to give it a go. MB is easily the most cost effective and result producing line I've fell for since transitioning to cruelty free cosmetics and skincare. My problem is having PCOS and excess facial hair that requires shaving every morning, it'd been hard to find that toner [and the accompanying 'seaweed cleansing soap'] to rely on in the mornings after shaving. I'll forever keep backups of this, and the cleansing soap, as they're extremely gentle and do exactly what I need them to.. they don't burn or irritate the freshly shaven areas of my face when applied afterwards, and bring that balance and moisture back into my skin before moisturizing and makeup. For any other women having the same issues, or men looking for something effective and gentle, I can not recommend this line enough! It has the slightest smell that I wouldn't call pleasant, but it dissipates quickly and isn't a strong, intrusive scent, at all.
I double cleanse and this product is still able to picks up impurities. I put it on before essences and creams as it does leave the skin clean and dry.
By far the best toner does not irritate my skin but leaves my combination skin perfect!
One of my all-time favorites in the Mario skincare line! This stuff smells AMAZING and leaves your skin feeling so clean.

I have sensitive/oily skin and this toner works well. It helps remove any makeup that I missed when cleansing my face and leaves my skin feeling clean. I do wish that it minimized pores. I use it daily and have't seen any improvement with pore size.

avis.titre: Finally used the whole bottle; would buy again!
avis.texte: I'm the kind of person that likes to stick to sample sizes, so I can try a variety of products. However, I bought this one in full size last year (after having success with other mario badescu products) and I've actually used the entire thing! It lasted FOREVER; definitely worth the price, for the amount of product you get. For me, this product works best for cleansing your face more than once a day. I have sensitive, combination, very redness-prone skin (i used to have to apply ointment around my nose / mouth / under my eyes every night) and I decided to buy this because I was looking for something gentle and natural, but effective. It says the seaweed is exfoliating, but I think it's about the softest exfoliator I've ever tried. Even though I prefer stronger, that's part of what makes it good for twice-daily cleansing. And I've had 0 negative reactions / side effects from this, as far as I can tell. There's only two minor downsides; 1) the little seaweed chunks tend to accumulate around my sink if I don't wash them down the drain right away. and 2) once you get to the last quarter of the bottle, you have to start keeping it upside down. I'm at the stage where I'm wasting almost as much product as I'm using, just trying to get the last of it out. But even given that, it's still worth the money. Just a little annoying. I would totally recommend this and buy it again. I'm considering trying another Badescu cleanser this time around, but this product worked so well I'm not sure

avis.titre: The only toner I'll ever use!
avis.texte: I cannot say enough about this product. As someone with dry and sensitive skin I'm always hesitant to try new products, especially toners. However, I was hooked on this the moment I tried it! What sticks out to me is the fact that it's super gentle and doesn't dry out my skin - a very cool and smooth application. I use this before bed on a daily basis after cleansing, and my face has never felt more balanced. It really gets all the unseen makeup my cleanser may have missed. What's even better is that it's alcohol AND paraben-free. Also, the price is amazing for this kind of quality. Just a really great product overall.

I use day and evening after cleansing (I use the enzyme cleansing gel or seaweed cleansing soap from the same line as my cleanser). This is one of the best toners I've used. 1) alcohol free so no burning, 2) contains witch hazel which helps calm and soothe along with the seaweed extract, 3) good for combo/acne prone skin 4) doesn't cause breakouts!!!! My skin feels so refreshed after this toner. I hsve repurchased several times now. I did sone trial and error to get the best regimen for my testy skin with this line and this is now a staple product. LOVE IT!!!!!

I didn't realize how much my skin needed a toner after removing my makeup until I tried this product. It's super gentle yet very effect! I have sensitive combination skin and it breaks out too easily. This product is perfect for sensitive skin. The ingredients are all natural and it doesn't dry out my skin. I love this product.

This is the one product I absolutely have to have. It gets all of the dirt, sweat, and makeup that your face wash or makeup removing wipes might have missed. I got the smaller bottle in the dry/combo kit amd HAD to get a full size.

However Ive been breaking out and experienced CLOGGED PORES MORE THAN IVE HAD BEFORE- more whiteheads too. Im really not sure if I want to keep this product or not .
Love this toner! It's very gentle on the skin and it didn't break me out or irritate my already existing acne. I also really love the smell!

I use this toner at night before I put on my moisturizer. I really love how gentle it is and it preps my skin prior to moisturizing. It feels clean and lightweight. The price point is amazing for the quality.

I really like Mario Badescu products and I bought both the Enzyme Cleansing Gel and the Seaweed Cleansing Lotion. I interchange between the two, but I really enjoy the Seaweed cleanser over the Enzyme cleanser for the main reason that it shows more improvement of my face. The enzyme, however, is a deeper clean in my opinion. While it does have a strong soapy smell, I wouldn't classify it as 'bad' as many people do on here. Admittedly, the Enzyme cleanser does smell much better. That being said, the Seaweed cleanser's smell fades within 10 minutes. I have big pores across my nose and cheeks, and the Seaweed cleanser is a great way to clean out my pores and helps shrink them down. My face also feels more moisturized with this soap then with most cleansers, but without the greasy feeling after. A little goes a long way, and I'm still using my bottle that I purchased in May. I will repurchase when I run out.

For one the cap makes a huge mess, its just an open cap that you unscrew so you tend to waste product a lot. This face wash is gentle on the skin but almost leaves a greasy feeling on the skin. Also, my husband used this face wash and he broke out with huge blackheads on his cheek. Like HUGE! If you're a popaholic like me, then it was enjoyable to go after his blackheads, but also not good that after a few uses it clogged his pores so much. Not worth it...

avis.titre: Excellent for dry acne prone skin

Other acne products dry my skin out completely to the point of flaking and cracking. This does not. Usually, products meant to keep moisture in your skin end up giving me clogged pores and horrible breakouts. This does not. It is non-drying and non-pore clogging. I love it. I notice it doesn't exactly FIGHT acne but it doesn't CAUSE it like other products. And it doesn't dry my skin out. I use this with the MB seaweed night cream AND MY SKIN IS SO NICE. My skin is not dry at all, and not full of product-induced acne. I do however get hormonal acne and this DOES NOT MAKE IT WORSE like many other products. Keeps it under control. I recommend this to anybody with dry acne prone skin
